why: WG asks the player: `select from:ADJ_VALUE "Select a Lore"`. We hardcoded trainedLore:"Angel", which build.ts:2333 trains unconditionally as lore:Angel — every eidolon-contact character got Angel Lore and was never asked. The printed clause is open-ended ("a Lore skill for the creature associated with your contacted eidolon (such as Angel Lore or Dragon Lore)") — the parenthesis is illustrative. We both encode this and we encode it differently, so ours is deleted.

Their reading, in our field. trainedLoreChoice renders the free-text Lore box (builder/shared.tsx:2813, gated on !trainedLoreOptions.length) and build.ts:2359 slugifies build.backgroundLore into lore:<subject> = trained. Free text, not a picker list, because the subject is open-ended — matching their unconstrained "Select a Lore". Probe: backgroundLore="Dragon" now yields lore:dragon (was lore:Angel); Dubious Knowledge and the Arcana/Nature/Occultism/Religion pick are untouched.
